units.source_text: “真一小时候胆子小，却很可爱，长得就像女孩子那样漂亮，

en.t: When Shinichi was little, he was timid, but very lovable, and he was as pretty as a girl,

units.source_text: 还被选去当童男，真傻。”哥哥说罢，放声大笑起来。

en.t: and he was even chosen to serve as a festival boy. How silly.” After saying this, his older brother burst out laughing.
